en.t: No, it was still too early to give up.

units.source_text: 听说有一处通往屏风岩的道路，实在不行的话，就往海里一跳，绕到海角的背面，也并非没有可能。

en.t: He had heard there was a road leading to Screen Rock; if nothing else worked, he could jump into the sea and make his way around to the back of the cape, which was not entirely impossible.

units.source_text: 一想到被抓回去，现在这情况，可就没有犹豫的余地了吧。

en.t: When he thought of being caught and dragged back, in the situation he was in now, there was surely no room left for hesitation.
